ownership.quote: I knew a solution like Browserless could dramatically simplify the work and maintenance, but none existed, so I started Browserless. Joel Griffith, Founder & CEO

stage.quote: Browserless is here so you don't have to pay a team of engineers to build, deploy, and maintain these systems.
stage.note: No accelerator, investor, or funding-round language found on the company's own About/Pricing pages, its GitHub org, or in Hacker News coverage (including the 2017 Launch HN post) in the time budget; Crunchbase was blocked (Cloudflare) and no press coverage of a raise was found. Absence of evidence is not proof of no funding, so this is a low-confidence inference from a single-founder narrative rather than a confirmed statement of 'bootstrapped'.

note: Founded by Joel Griffith (Founder & CEO), who describes starting Browserless solo after hitting headless-Chrome infrastructure pain as an engineer (About page). Launched publicly via 'Launch HN: Browserless. Hosted headless Chrome' (Nov 2017). GitHub org 'browserless' created 2019-05-31. Company markets itself on customer/usage traction (10,000+ paying customers, 13,000+ GitHub stars, 175M+ Docker pulls) rather than any funding milestone, and no VC, accelerator, or press-covered raise could be found — consistent with, but not confirmed as, a bootstrapped/independent company. A buyer should treat the funding stage and total-funding fields as unverified rather than assume no capital was ever raised.
